snippet.title: Raining Lead | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
We’re excited to finally reveal our new upcoming game,  Raining Lead! 🔥

Raining Lead is a twin-stick shooter about a heavily armed robot, a city under Mega Giga Corp control, and solving problems the loudest way possible! 

Wishlist now here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3985540?utm_source=yt

Check out https://www.raininglead.com/
Join our discord: https://discord.gg/9quHFNH54t
